formats.key: addLiquidity(uint256 amount0, uint256 amount1, address to)
effects: Pulls amount0 of token0 (zkUSD) from the signer into the pool.
Pulls amount1 of token1 (USDC) from the signer into the pool.
Mints LP shares (PAR-LP) to `to`; the number is computed from reserves and total supply, and 1000 shares are locked on the first deposit.
formats.shown: Add the zkUSD and USDC amounts and send the resulting shares to the named recipient.

findings.title: addLiquidity: the number of shares minted is not shown because it comes from storage.
findings.evidence: ParSwapPool.sol addLiquidity: `shares = Math.mulDiv(value, supply, reserve0 + reserve1)`. The descriptor has no shares field because nothing in calldata holds it.
findings.fix: None possible. The wording 'shares to {to}' is enough.

effects: Sets the spender's allowance over the signer's PAR-LP shares to `value`. Max uint256 is never decreased.
formats.shown: Approve the stated amount of PAR-LP (or Unlimited) for the named spender.

formats.key: removeLiquidity(uint256 shares, uint256 minAmount0, uint256 minAmount1, address to)
effects: Sends a pro-rata share of reserve0 in zkUSD to `to`, at least minAmount0, or the call reverts.
Sends a pro-rata share of reserve1 in USDC to `to`, at least minAmount1, or the call reverts.
formats.shown: Redeem the stated PAR-LP to the recipient, with a minimum zkUSD and a minimum USDC shown as fields.

findings.title: removeLiquidity: the sentence 'Redeem {shares} to {to}' suggests the shares go to the recipient and leaves out the tokens received.
findings.evidence: descriptor removeLiquidity interpolatedIntent 'Redeem {shares} to {to}'. In ParSwapPool.sol _settleWithdrawal the shares are burned from msg.sender and token0/token1 are sent to `to`.
findings.fix: Use 'Burn {shares} for at least {minAmount0} and {minAmount1}, sent to {to}'.

formats.key: removeLiquidityExact(uint256 amount0, uint256 amount1, uint256 maxShares, address to)
effects: Burns PAR-LP from the signer, computed at the reserve ratio and rounded up, capped at maxShares.
formats.shown: Withdraw the exact zkUSD and USDC amounts to the recipient, with a share cap (or 'No limit') shown as a field.

findings.title: removeLiquidityExact: the exact shares burned come from storage; only the cap is shown.
findings.evidence: ParSwapPool.sol removeLiquidityExact: `shares = Math.mulDiv(value, totalSupply(), r0 + r1, Math.Rounding.Ceil)`. The field 'Maximum shares' shows maxShares, or 'No limit' at max.
findings.fix: None needed beyond the cap. You could add 'burning up to {maxShares}' to the sentence.

effects: Sends every token0 and token1 balance above the tracked reserves to `to`. Nothing is taken from the signer.
formats.shown: Send the pool's excess to the recipient.

findings.title: skim: the amounts swept are balances minus reserves, read on chain and not in calldata.

formats.key: swap(address tokenIn, uint256 amount, address to)
effects: Pulls `amount` of tokenIn (zkUSD or USDC) from the signer through an allowance.
Sends exactly `amount` of the other pool token to `to`, 1:1 with no fee. It reverts if the reserve is short.
formats.shown: Swap the paid amount of tokenIn and send to the recipient. The token received and its amount are never stated.

findings.title: swap: the output token and the amount received (equal to the input, 1:1) appear nowhere on the screen.
findings.evidence: ParSwapPool.sol _settleSwap: `token1.safeTransfer(to, amount)` / `token0.safeTransfer(to, amount)`. The descriptor swap fields are only 'Pay' {amount} with tokenPath tokenIn and 'To'. Case 5 reads 'Swap 21.37 zkUSD, send to Bob' and never says Bob gets 21.37 USDC.
findings.fix: State the output in the sentence, e.g. 'Swap {amount} 1:1 for the same amount of the other pool token (zkUSD/USDC), sent to {to}'. Also add a 'Receive (1:1)' field on amount.

formats.key: swapPushed(address tokenIn, uint256 amount, address to)
effects: Pulls nothing from the signer in this call. It consumes `amount` of tokenIn already held above the reserve, whoever pushed it.
Sends exactly `amount` of the other pool token to `to`, 1:1.
formats.shown: Swap the stated amount (labelled 'Pay') and send to the recipient. The token received is not stated.

findings.title: swapPushed: the output token and amount sent to the recipient (1:1 other pool token) are not shown.
findings.evidence: ParSwapPool.sol swapPushed -> _settleSwap: `token1.safeTransfer(to, amount)` or `token0.safeTransfer(to, amount)`. The descriptor fields are only 'Pay' {amount} (tokenIn) and 'To'.
findings.fix: Say 'for {amount} of the other pool token (1:1), sent to {to}' in the interpolatedIntent and add a receive field.

findings.title: swapPushed: the label 'Pay' implies the call takes tokens from the signer, but it uses tokens already in the pool.
findings.evidence: ParSwapPool.sol swapPushed: `received = balanceOf(address(this)) - reserveIn; require(received >= amount)` and there is no transferFrom. The descriptor field label is 'Pay'.
findings.fix: Relabel it 'Pre-funded input' and say in the intent that the tokens must already be in the pool in the same transaction.

formats.key: swapWithAuthorization(address tokenIn, uint256 amount, address from, uint256 validAfter, uint256 validBefore, bytes32 nonce, bytes signature)
effects: Uses `from`'s EIP-3009 authorization to pull `amount` of tokenIn from `from` (who may be the signer). The nonce is consumed.
Sends exactly `amount` of the other pool token to `from`, 1:1.
formats.shown: Swap the stated tokenIn amount from the named owner, valid before a date. Neither the output token nor who receives it is stated.

findings.title: swapWithAuthorization: the output token and amount, and that the output goes to `from`, are not shown.
findings.evidence: ParSwapPool.sol swapWithAuthorization: `_settleSwap(zeroForOne, amount, tokenIn, from)` sends the other token to `from`. The descriptor fields are 'Pay', 'From' and 'Valid before', and the sentence is 'Swap {amount} from {from}'.
findings.fix: Use 'Swap {amount} from {from} 1:1 for the same amount of the other pool token, sent back to {from}'.

findings.title: swapWithAuthorization: validAfter and the nonce are not shown. They only bound the authorization window.
findings.evidence: The descriptor shows only validBefore. ParSwapPool.sol passes validAfter and nonce to IERC3009.receiveWithAuthorization.
findings.fix: Optionally add validAfter as a date field.

effects: Moves `value` PAR-LP shares from the signer to `to`.
formats.shown: Send the stated PAR-LP amount to the recipient.

formats.key: transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 value)
effects: Moves `value` PAR-LP from `from` to `to` and spends the signer's allowance from `from`, unless it is unlimited.
formats.shown: Send the stated PAR-LP amount from the owner to the recipient.

findings.format: swap(address tokenIn, uint256 amount, address to)
findings.title: swap: the output token and the amount received (equal to the input, 1:1) appear nowhere on the screen.
findings.reason: The screen shows the amount paid with its token (via tokenPath), and the recipient. The output is the same amount of the pool's other immutable token, which the contract picks from `tokenIn`. No ERC-7730 field can choose 'the other token' from `tokenIn`, so this is an output decided by the pool: info / spec-limitation under not_critical #3, at most a wording warning. No amount differs from what is shown, and no sibling format shows an output that this one leaves out.
findings.quote: ParSwapPool.sol _settleSwap: `if (zeroForOne) { ... token1.safeTransfer(to, amount); } else { ... token0.safeTransfer(to, amount); }`; _sideOf: `zeroForOne = tokenIn == address(token0)`. Descriptor swap: field 'Pay' {amount} tokenPath tokenIn, field 'To' {to}; case 5 screen 'Pay 21.37 zkUSD', 'To Bob'.

findings.format: swapPushed(address tokenIn, uint256 amount, address to)
findings.title: swapPushed: the output token and amount sent to the recipient (1:1 other pool token) are not shown.
findings.reason: This is the same situation as finding 0. The amount and the input token are shown, and so is the recipient. The output token is derived by the contract from the immutable pair, so a descriptor cannot show it: info / spec-limitation (not_critical #3). The output amount equals the amount shown, so no other amount or recipient is involved. The 'Pay' label can mislead, but that is a separate warning.
findings.quote: ParSwapPool.sol swapPushed: `_settleSwap(zeroForOne, amount, tokenIn, to); return amount;` with `@param amount Amount pushed in, which is also the amount out.` Descriptor swapPushed fields: 'Pay' {amount} (tokenPath tokenIn), 'To' {to}.

findings.format: swapWithAuthorization(address tokenIn, uint256 amount, address from, uint256 validAfter, uint256 validBefore, bytes32 nonce, bytes signature)
findings.title: swapWithAuthorization: the output token and amount, and that the output goes to `from`, are not shown.
findings.reason: The output recipient is `from`, and `from` is shown as its own field and in the sentence. The contract always pays out to the owner who signed the authorization, which is not_critical #3/#4. A relayer who submits the call has none of their own assets moved, and if the signer is `from`, the funds return to them. The output token and amount have the same pool-derived spec-limitation as finding 0.
findings.quote: ParSwapPool.sol swapWithAuthorization: `IERC3009(tokenIn).receiveWithAuthorization(from, address(this), amount, ...); _settleSwap(zeroForOne, amount, tokenIn, from);` with the comment 'Output always goes to `from`: a relayer cannot redirect it.' Descriptor: field 'From' {from}, interpolatedIntent 'Swap {amount} from {from}'.
